user.title: Action Control
user.description: Set up Action Control. You will define watchdog rules afterwards, from the integration's Configure button.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Action Control is already configured; only one instance is needed.

add_rule.title: Rule – what to watch
add_rule.description: Choose which domain(s) this rule watches, and which entities it applies to. The next step lets you pick the services to watch within these domains.

add_rule_services.title: Rule – which services
add_rule_services.description: Services actually available for {domains} are suggested below; leave empty to watch every service in these domains, or type a service name that isn't listed.

data.services: Services (empty = any service in the domain)

rule_verify.title: Rule – verification & retries
rule_verify.description: Define how the outcome is checked and how retries are handled.

data.attributes_to_check: Attributes to check (in addition to state)
data.wait_for_change: Wait for an attribute to actually start changing (e.g. position covers) instead of a snapshot check
data.change_attribute: Attribute to watch for a change (e.g. current_position)

rule_escalation.title: Rule – escalation & notifications
rule_escalation.description: Optionally define a recovery action (e.g. turning on a switch, or running a script) to run when verification keeps failing, and how you want to be notified.

data.escalation_replay_delay: Delay after escalation before replaying the command (seconds)
data.notify_service: Also notify via this notify service

delete_rule_confirm.title: Confirm deletion
delete_rule_confirm.description: Delete rule "{rule_name}"? This cannot be undone.

data.default_retries: Default number of retries for new rules
data.default_retry_delay: Default delay between retries for new rules (seconds)

abort.no_rules: No rule has been configured yet.
